title: How Early Wi‑Fi Connected a Café

scenes.text: Which 1993 coffee shop pioneered public Wi‑Fi?

scenes.label: THE HONEYWELL BEEHIVE HUB
scenes.text: The Café BEEHIVE installed a Honeywell WaveLAN router, the first commercial wireless LAN.

scenes.label: 10‑METER RANGE COVERAGE
scenes.text: The system covered roughly ten meters, enough for customers to browse the web from any table.

scenes.label: INFLUENCE ON TODAY'S HOTSPOTS
scenes.text: That modest setup inspired the modern hotspot model used in cafés worldwide.
